Hand colored. Prime meridian: Ferro and London. Relief shown pictorially. "N.B. The letters E, F, S, D, Da, annexed to the names of the islands, denote them to belong either to the English, French, Spanish, Dutch, Danes, &c." Described in United States Library of Congress, The Lowery collection, no. 659. Insets: A particular map of Baffin and Hudson's Bay.--The passage by land to California discover'd by Father Eusebius Francis Kino a Jesuit; between the years 1698 and 1701, before which, and for a considerable time since California has always been described in all charts & maps as an island. Scale ca. 1:6,750,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2
